audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1] and phases[3] key levels 2 and 4-5 to Infinite Duress, which he does not have until 6. phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds'.
audit.why: Before 6 the cooldowns that decide trades are Jaws of the Beast (Q, 8s at rank 1 down to 6s, a dash that heals him for max-health damage) and Primal Howl (E, 15s down to 11s). Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 down to 70s — that is the number worth stating, and it appears nowhere.
audit.corrected: phases[1] and phases[3] re-keyed to Jaws of the Beast; the 110s given at level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl is absent from the entire entry, and Eternal Hunger's thresholds are described only as 'low-HP lifesteal'.
audit.why: Primal Howl (E, 15s at rank 1 down to 11s) gives him 2.5 seconds of damage reduction and then FEARS everyone nearby for a second — it blanks the burst window this entry tells you to force, and the fear takes your positioning away at the exact moment you were going to hop out. Eternal Hunger heals him only below 50% health and TRIPLES that healing below 25%, which is why 'drop him while he is still above 50%' is right but understated: below a quarter health he is healing three times as fast.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on Jaws of the Beast and Primal Howl; the 50%/25% thresholds stated exactly.
